definitions: An industry that profits from people's sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically by producing or marketing products, services, or experiences that evoke or recreate past eras.
The sector of the economy focused on commercialising historical periods, cultural trends, or personal memories to appeal to consumers' desire for the past.
examples: The nostalgia industry thrives on re-releasing classic video games.
Many theme parks are part of the nostalgia industry.
The film's success highlights the power of the nostalgia industry.
